subject: ela
intro: Seventh graders determine two or more central ideas in a text and analyze their development over the course of the text, and provide an objective summary. A central idea is the main point the author makes; it is supported by details and develops as the text progresses. An objective summary has no opinions.

items.prompt:
Read.

Exercise benefits both body and mind. It strengthens the heart and muscles, and research shows it also reduces stress and improves mood.

Name TWO central ideas.

steps: I find the two main points.
One: exercise benefits the body (heart, muscles). Two: it benefits the mind (stress, mood).
So the two central ideas are physical and mental benefits of exercise.
solution.answer: Exercise benefits the body and benefits the mind.

steps: An objective summary states key points without opinion.
So: 'Exercise strengthens the body and improves mental health by reducing stress and boosting mood.'
solution.answer: Exercise strengthens the body and improves mental health.

items.prompt: An objective summary excludes the writer's ____.

Read.

The rainforest is rich in species and vital for the climate.

Two central ideas?

solution.answer: It is rich in species and vital for the climate.

items.prompt: A central idea is supported by ____.
A brief, opinion-free retelling is an ____ summary.
